product_decisions.question: If task creation fails partway through a reviewed batch, should already-created tasks remain and the remainder retry, or must the batch be all-or-nothing?
product_decisions.answer: Per-action durable: already-created tasks stay and a retry idempotently completes only the remaining actions (ADR-0002 per-action commit semantics, not whole-batch rollback). Delivered as a frozen-batch phased saga (T033); commit idempotency/concurrency hardening is release-closure task T038.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md Clarifications (2026-07-29), FR-015, US1 scenario 4; ADR-0002 sections 485-519; tasks.md T033/T038

product_decisions.question: Is a correctly transcribed proper noun mandatory, or is dropping a task with a garbled proper noun acceptable until follow-up tolerance?
product_decisions.answer: Fail-closed omission accepted. FR-001 narrowed: proper-noun preservation is best-effort; heavily garbled nouns are not guessed and dependent proposals fail closed (FR-016 tolerance recovers close mishears). Edge Cases and success criteria aligned.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md Clarifications (2026-07-29), FR-001, FR-016, proper-noun Edge Case

product_decisions.question: What is the canonical title-fidelity rule for generated task proposals (given code-switched utterances and multi-language evidence)?
product_decisions.answer: Language-faithful rewrites: titles preserve the source language, intent, proper nouns, and embedded foreign terms; grammatical inflection and grounded rewording are allowed (not necessarily a verbatim subsequence); omission of non-core details for conciseness is allowed; translation is prohibited. Extractive-subsequence declined (contradicts FR-008). FR-006/007/008 rewritten to separate title-generation from grounding; delivered title-shape invariant (T037).
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md Clarifications (2026-07-29), FR-006, FR-007, FR-008, US1 scenario 1, SC-003; tasks.md T037

product_decisions.question: What exposure is allowed while the feature remains below ADR-0002's release-quality targets?
product_decisions.answer: Founder-only INTERNAL, below targets. BrainBuddy is single-user today; ~88% corpus accuracy is accepted for the founder's own use. Code lands/deploys with voice_brain_dump OFF; a founder-only INTERNAL experiment below targets is approved; public ON stays gated on the ADR-0002 targets (>=95% task-count/boundary, 100% critical-term) if/when the product gains other users. 'Stable' means stable for founder-only INTERNAL, not a public release.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md Clarifications + Status (2026-07-29); plan.md Release gates (Exposure gate); ADR-0002 2026-07-19 amendment; ADR-0008

product_decisions.question: Does 'no audio leaves the device' prohibit browser->BrainBuddy upload until the complete vendor set is consented, or only prohibit forwarding to external vendors?
product_decisions.answer: First-party processing boundary: audio MAY cross browser->BrainBuddy-server; the normative guarantee is no external-provider egress and no persistence without complete named-vendor consent. The backend pre-persistence/pre-provider rejection is the correct primary SC-006 evidence; the first-party client capture gate is defense-in-depth. US2/FR-011/FR-012/SC-006 and consent copy amended.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md Clarifications, US2 scenario 2, FR-011/FR-012, SC-006 (2026-07-29); plan.md Data handling + Test strategy

product_decisions.question: After working-artifact retention expires, must a committed task remain traceable to the exact utterance text, or are immutable IDs and hashes sufficient?
product_decisions.answer: Review-time + retention-window exact text, then IDs/hashes. Exact cited-utterance text is traceable during Review and for the configurable retention window; after it, durable provenance is immutable IDs + content hashes only (exact text purged). Window is environment-configurable. FR-002, Key Entities, and plan Data handling amended.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md Clarifications, FR-002, Key Entities (2026-07-29); plan.md Data handling (Provenance lifecycle)
